verdict.rationale: The only multi-item operation documented is item merging, which combines several items into one group (rollbar-docs-4). The REST API can list and paginate filtered items (rollbar-docs-14, rollbar-docs-15, rollbar-docs-35), so a user could script per-item changes across many items. Nothing shows a native bulk action such as resolving, muting, or reassigning many items in one call or UI step. Missing for 10: documented bulk status/owner updates across many items, a bulk API endpoint, AI/MCP-driven bulk actions, and hands-on corroboration.
